values.content:
=Analyze this HVAC lead and return ONLY valid JSON.

LEAD DATA:
- Name: {{ $json.name || 'Not provided' }}
- First Name: {{ $json.firstName }}
- Email: {{ $json.email }}
- Phone: {{ $json.phone || 'Not provided' }}
- Company: {{ $json.company || 'Not provided' }}
- Service Type: {{ $json.service_type || 'Not provided' }}
- Property Type: {{ $json.property_type || 'Not provided' }}
- Urgency: {{ $json.urgency || 'Not provided' }}
- Location/ZIP: {{ $json.location || 'Not provided' }}
- Budget: {{ $json.budget || 'Not provided' }}
- Message: {{ $json.message || 'No message provided' }}
- Submitted: {{ $json.submittedAt }}

STEP 1 - READ THE LEAD:
Identify: their specific HVAC problem, urgency level, property type, and tone.
If message is vague, infer from Service Type and Urgency fields.

STEP 2 - SCORE THE LEAD:
HOT:
- Urgency = "ASAP" or message contains emergency/broken/not working/no AC/no heat
- Phone number provided
- Specific unit, service type, or location mentioned
- Commercial project with budget

WARM:
- Clear service type selected (install, maintenance, commercial)
- Location provided
- Budget or timeline given
- Message has detail but no urgency signals

COLD:
- Urgency = "Just exploring"
- No phone number
- No service type or location
- Vague or one-line message
- Looks like spam or test submission

STEP 3 - WRITE THE EMAIL:
Use this structure:

Subject: Got your request, [FirstName] - here's what happens next

Hey [FirstName],

[1 sentence validating their specific HVAC problem - make them feel heard. Emergency? Lead with speed. Install? Lead with getting it right.]

[1-2 sentences: what the delay costs them - comfort, safety, or money - then: "We're on it."]

Here's what happens next:
? [Specific next step - e.g. "A certified tech will call you within the hour"]
? [Reassurance - e.g. "Upfront pricing before any work begins - no surprises"]
? [Trust signal - e.g. "Licensed, insured, and local"]

[CTA: Call us at [PHONE] or reply here and we'll call you.]

EMAIL RULES:
- Under 100 words total
- Emergency leads: emphasize SPEED ("within the hour", "today")
- Installation/maintenance leads: emphasize getting the assessment booked
- One sentence per paragraph
- No "thanks for reaching out", no "we look forward to hearing from you"
- Plain text only - no HTML
- Separate every paragraph and bullet with \n\n
- Bullets exactly: ? Benefit\n\n? Benefit\n\n? Benefit

Return ONLY this JSON (no markdown fences, no extra text):
{
  "score": "hot|warm|cold",
  "score_reason": "1-2 sentences explaining the score",
  "email_subject": "Got your request, [FirstName] - here's what happens next",
  "email_body": "Full email using structure above",
  "follow_up_priority": "high|medium|low",
  "key_signals": ["signal1", "signal2"]
}

parameters.content:
## Speed-to-Lead: AI-Qualified HVAC Replies

Turns a Tally form submission into an instant, AI-scored reply so hot leads get a response in minutes, not hours.

### How it works
1. Tally webhook captures the form and normalizes messy field names into a clean lead object.
2. Claude scores the lead Hot / Warm / Cold and drafts a short personalized reply.
3. Hot leads route through a priority send; Warm/Cold use the standard branch - both email the customer via Gmail.
4. The lead is logged to Google Sheets, matched by email/phone to avoid duplicate rows, and a full lead brief is emailed to sales.
5. If the lead hasn't booked, automatic follow-ups fire on Day 2 and Day 5. A booking webhook marks the row "Booked" and stops further follow-ups.

### Setup
- Connect Anthropic, Gmail, and Google Sheets credentials
- Point all Google Sheets nodes at your CRM sheet
- Point your Tally form's webhook at /hvac-speed-to-lead
- Set your sales team email in "Send Lead Brief to Sales"
- Wire your booking tool to call /hvac-lead-booked on confirmed bookings

### Customization tips
Swap the scoring prompt for another trade (plumbing, roofing), adjust the Hot/Warm/Cold criteria, or change follow-up timing.

## 1. Capture & Normalize
Webhook receives the Tally submission and flattens it into a clean lead object.

## 2. AI Score & Draft
Claude scores Hot/Warm/Cold and drafts a reply, then routes hot leads to a priority send.

## 3. CRM Dedupe & Sales Brief
Matches lead by email/phone, updates or appends the row, then emails a lead brief to sales.

## 4. Follow-ups & Booking
Day 2 / Day 5 nudges fire only if the lead hasn't booked; a booking webhook stops them.

## Critical: dedupe search settings

On "Search Google Sheets by Email/Phone":
- Options > Combine Filters must be set to OR (default AND breaks matching)
- Settings tab > turn ON "Always Output Data" (without it, brand-new leads silently never get logged)
- Watch for trailing newline characters in the saved Email/Phone filter expressions - they silently break matching too
